note: Career-mode events. DATA, not code — adding an event means adding an object here. A FORCED event (forced:true) has exactly one option and no choice in it - an injury, a relegation - and its single option must be certain, so nobody is made to roll dice they did not choose. Every option's odds must sum to 1.0, and at least one option per event must be certain (a safe out). Tone: situations that are funny or painful because they are plausible, never winks at the player. Every outcome of a MULTI-outcome option carries a short label, used by the reveal animation that flips between the possibilities before landing on the one that happened.

events.title: A new manager
events.body: {club} have sacked the coach who signed you. The new one has his own ideas.

options.label: Fight for your place
options.note: 55% he comes round · 45% frozen out

win.copy: You won him over in pre-season.

options.label: Ask to leave now
options.note: Certain — you force a move

go.copy: You handed in a transfer request.

events.title: The armband
events.body: The dressing room at {club} wants you as captain.

options.label: Take the armband
options.note: Certain — leadership, and the weight of it

options.label: Stay one of the lads
options.note: Certain — keep your own game clean

no.copy: You let someone else carry it.

events.title: An offer that is too good
events.body: Your agent has found a club willing to triple your wages. He is vague about who owns them.

options.label: Take the money
options.note: 40% it is fine · 60% the wages stop

fine.copy: It was fine. You have never been richer.

unpaid.copy: Three months without wages, and a season lost to it.

options.label: Stay where the football is
options.note: Certain — no windfall, no mess

stay.copy: You told him to find you a pitch, not a payday.

events.title: It came out wrong
events.body: A tired answer after a bad defeat is on every back page by morning.

options.label: Apologise publicly
options.note: Certain — it blows over

sorry.copy: You fronted up. It blew over in a week.

options.label: Say nothing
options.note: 60% forgotten · 40% it follows you

quiet.copy: You said nothing and it died on its own.

follows.copy: It followed you to every away ground for a year.

events.title: A long way from home
events.body: Second winter abroad. The football is fine. Everything else is not.

options.label: Push through it
options.note: 65% you settle · 35% it wears you down

settle.copy: You learned the language and stopped counting the days.

options.label: Engineer a move home
options.note: Certain — go back, take the step down

home.copy: You went home. Smaller stage, happier.

events.title: The old pro
events.body: A veteran at {club} has taken an interest in you.

options.label: Listen to him
options.note: Certain — his habits become yours

listen.copy: He taught you how to train.

options.label: Go your own way
options.note: Certain — trust your own instincts

events.title: The final, and a bad ankle
events.body: {club} are in a final. The scan says you should not play.

options.label: Play through it
options.note: 45% hero · 55% out for months

hero.copy: You played, and you won it.

broken.copy: You lasted twenty minutes. Then six months.

options.label: Sit it out
options.note: Certain — watch from the bench, stay fit

rest.copy: You watched it in a suit.

events.title: A league you do not know
events.body: An offer from a country whose football is nothing like yours.

options.label: Go
options.note: 50% you adapt and thrive · 50% you never settle

options.label: Stay in familiar football
options.note: Certain — no upside, no risk

stay.copy: You stayed where you knew the game.

events.title: Drop deeper
events.body: The legs are going. A coach thinks you could play a different role for another five years.

options.label: Reinvent yourself
options.note: 60% a second career · 40% you lose your edge

renew.copy: You learned a new position at 30.

lost.copy: You were neither one thing nor the other.

options.label: Play your game while it lasts
options.note: Certain — no change

same.copy: You played the only way you knew.

events.title: The money move
events.body: A rich league, a smaller stage, and more money than you will ever be offered again.

options.label: Take it
options.note: Certain — paid, and out of the shop window

options.label: Stay relevant
options.note: Certain — less money, still watched

stay.copy: You stayed where people were watching.

events.title: The knee
events.body: It went in training, without contact. Those are the bad ones.

options.label: Rush the rehab
options.note: 40% back early · 60% you break down again

early.copy: You were back inside four months.

again.copy: You came back twice and broke down twice.

options.label: Take the full year
options.note: Certain — a season gone, knee intact

full.copy: You gave it a full year.

events.title: Going down
events.body: {club} are relegated. You were their best player.

options.label: Go down with them
options.note: Certain — loyalty, and a smaller stage

options.label: Jump
options.note: Certain — someone always calls

jump.copy: You were gone within a fortnight.

events.title: Nobody asked you
events.body: {club} have accepted a bid. You found out from your phone.

options.label: Refuse to go
options.note: 35% they back down · 65% you rot in the reserves

stay.copy: You dug in and they backed down.

rot.copy: You trained with the kids until January.

options.label: Go, and go well
options.note: Certain — take the move on your terms

go.copy: You left with a straight back.

events.title: Your country calls
events.body: A first senior call-up. The manager wants you in the squad.

options.label: Go, and play everything
options.note: Certain — caps, and tired legs

options.label: Focus on your club
options.note: Certain — no caps, fresher legs

events.title: The derby
events.body: One game decides how this city remembers your season.

options.label: Demand the ball
options.note: 55% you decide it · 45% you are the one who missed

hero.copy: You scored the winner. They still sing about it.

villain.copy: You missed the chance. They remember that too.
villain.short: you are the one who missed

options.label: Play it simple
options.note: Certain — no hero, no villain

events.title: A full house
events.body: {club} want to give you a testimonial. Ten years is a long time anywhere.

options.label: Take the night
options.note: Certain — a full house, and a decision to make

yes.copy: They filled the ground for you.

options.label: Not yet
options.note: Certain — you are not finished

no.copy: You told them you were not done.

events.title: The knee goes
events.body: A twist, a noise, and a season that stops being about football. {club} say take the time.

options.label: Start the rehab
options.note: −2 OVR · fewer games next season

only.copy: Five months. You came back a step slower and learned to play a step earlier.

events.title: Down
events.body: {club} go down on the last day. The good players will not all stay, and neither will the money.

options.label: Report back for pre-season
options.note: the phone stops ringing for a while

only.copy: A division lower, a smaller crowd, and nobody from the bigger clubs watching.

events.title: Your agent drops you
events.body: He has a young client at a bigger club and only so many hours. You find out by email.

options.label: Read it twice, then get on with it
options.note: nobody is working the phones for you

only.copy: For two years the moves came to you or they did not come at all.

events.title: The eagle
events.body: A tattoo studio offers to ink an eagle across your chest for nothing, if they can photograph it.

options.label: Let them do it
options.note: 70% you love it · 30% it goes wrong

win.copy: You have never taken your shirt off so often after a goal.

lose.copy: It got infected. You missed six weeks to a bird.

options.label: Keep your shirt on
options.note: nothing happens, which is the point

only.copy: You kept your chest, and the studio found a left-back who said yes.

events.title: Finish school
events.body: The club runs evening classes. Everyone says do it. Everyone also says training comes first.

options.label: Sit the exams
options.note: 80% you pass and sleep badly · 20% it costs you a season

win.copy: You passed. Nobody in football ever asked, and you were glad anyway.

lose.copy: You revised instead of recovering and had the worst season of your youth.

options.label: Football first
options.note: certain — the classroom empties without you

only.copy: You gave it up in October. It never came back around.

events.title: A very good agent calls
events.body: He has never seen anyone like you, he says, on a call he is clearly making from a car.

options.label: Sign with him
options.note: 55% he is right · 45% he is a car with a phone in it

win.copy: Two clubs you had not dreamed of rang inside a month.

lose.copy: He talked you out of the one move that was real.
lose.short: he is a car with a phone in it

options.label: Stay with the one you have
options.note: certain — no upside, no car

only.copy: Nothing changed, which at that moment was worth something.

events.title: The armband
events.body: The captain has gone and the dressing room is looking at two people. One of them is you.

options.label: Take it
options.note: 65% it makes you · 35% it is a weight

win.copy: You grew about a foot the day you first led them out.

lose.copy: You carried it badly and your own game went first.

options.label: Let the other one have it
options.note: certain — you keep playing your game

only.copy: He took it, and you had the best two years of your football underneath him.

events.title: From his own half
events.body: It bounced once, you were off your line, and it is on every highlights reel in the country.

options.label: Front up to the press
options.note: 60% they respect it · 40% it follows you anyway

win.copy: You stood there and answered all of it. The dressing room noticed.

lose.copy: Every away ground sang it at you for a year.

options.label: Say nothing and train
options.note: certain — it dies slower, but it dies

only.copy: You did extra sessions until the noise moved on to someone else.

events.title: Five kicks
events.body: A cup semi-final, and it comes down to you and five men walking up alone.

options.label: Go early, guess big
options.note: 45% you save two · 55% you dive past all five

win.copy: Two saves. They carried you off and the town did not sleep.

lose.copy: Five went in and you touched none of them.

options.label: Stay big, stay late
options.note: certain — no hero, no blame

only.copy: You got a hand to one and it went in anyway. Nobody blamed the keeper.

events.title: They have signed a keeper
events.body: Twenty-one, expensive, and the manager keeps calling him 'the future' in front of you.

options.label: Make him wait
options.note: 55% he waits · 45% he does not

win.copy: He sat for two years and you played every week.

lose.copy: He was in by Christmas and you were the one on the bench.

options.label: Ask to go somewhere you play
options.note: certain — you will not be here in August

only.copy: You went where the shirt was yours. Smaller club, every Saturday.

events.title: Red, and the derby lost
events.body: Two yellows in eleven minutes. They scored both goals while you watched from the tunnel.

options.label: Take the ban and the fine
options.note: certain — three games, and a quiet week

only.copy: You served it, said nothing, and were back in the side by the end of the month.

options.label: Blame the referee publicly
options.note: 30% the squad backs you · 70% the club fines you twice

win.copy: The captain agreed with you on camera and the manager quietly enjoyed it.

lose.copy: The club fined you again and the referees remembered your name.

events.title: He wants you in midfield
events.body: An injury crisis, and the manager thinks you can sit in front of the back four.

options.label: Learn the new job
options.note: 55% you can do both · 45% you belong in neither

win.copy: You could play both by Christmas, and a defender who can pass is worth more.

lose.copy: You lost the timing of one job without ever learning the other.

options.label: Tell him what you are
options.note: certain — you keep your own game

only.copy: He found someone else and you kept doing the thing you are good at.

events.title: Your partner is sold
events.body: Four years next to the same man. He goes on the Thursday and nobody tells you first.

options.label: Bring the young one through
options.note: certain — slower, and it is on you now

only.copy: You talked him through a whole season. He was decent by spring and you were exhausted.

options.label: Ask them to buy someone
options.note: certain — they buy experience, and it costs your minutes

only.copy: They signed a thirty-year-old international and he played ahead of you for a season.

events.title: Ten yards further back
events.body: You do not run like you did at 22. The manager says the game is easier from deeper.

options.label: Reinvent the role
options.note: 62% you last five more years · 38% you are neither one thing nor the other

win.copy: You stopped running and started deciding. It bought you half a career.

lose.copy: You lost the legs and never found the passes.
lose.short: you are neither one thing nor the other

options.label: Play the way you always have
options.note: certain — while it lasts

only.copy: You kept running box to box. It was glorious and it was not sustainable.

events.title: Who takes them?
events.body: The free-kick specialist has left and two of you are standing over the ball.

options.label: Take it
options.note: 50% you score from 25 yards · 50% you hit the wall twice

win.copy: Three in a season from outside the box. They started calling you for them.

lose.copy: You put two into the wall and the captain took the next one.

options.label: Give him the ball
options.note: certain — no glory, no wall

only.copy: He scored one and you got the assist for the rebound.

events.title: Nine games left
events.body: A groin that will not settle, and the club are two points off the top with nine to play.

options.label: Play through it
options.note: 48% you get them over the line · 52% it turns into six months

win.copy: You played all nine. They went up, and everyone knew what it cost you.
win.short: you get them over the line

lose.copy: It tore properly in April and took the rest of the year with it.

options.label: Six weeks off, now
options.note: certain — you miss the run-in, you keep the leg

only.copy: You watched the last nine from a box and came back sound.

events.title: Nine games
events.body: Nine without one. You are hitting the target and it is going straight at the keeper.

options.label: Keep shooting
options.note: 58% the tenth goes in · 42% it becomes a season

win.copy: Number ten went in off your shin and the next four were clean.

lose.copy: It never came back that year. You finished with four.

options.label: Drop off and make them instead
options.note: certain — fewer goals, more football

only.copy: You stopped chasing it and made eleven for other people.

events.title: The penalties
events.body: You want them. So does the captain, and he has taken them for three years.

options.label: Take them off him
options.note: 55% you never miss · 45% you miss the one that mattered

win.copy: Twelve from twelve, and it made your season look like someone else's.

lose.copy: You missed in the last minute of the derby and he took them back.
lose.short: you miss the one that mattered

options.label: Let him keep them
options.note: certain — his goals, your football

only.copy: He finished top scorer on penalties and you outplayed him all year.

events.title: They have bought a striker
events.body: Club record fee, and the manager says there is 'absolutely room for both of you'.

options.label: Play alongside him
options.note: 52% you feed off each other · 48% one of you sits

win.copy: You got eleven assists and he got the headlines. It worked.

lose.copy: He played and you did not. That was the whole season.

options.label: Go where you are the striker
options.note: certain — smaller badge, your shirt

only.copy: You dropped a level and scored twenty.
